exercises.instructions: Decide whether each noun is countable or uncountable. Choose the correct answer.

questions.question: The children are playing in the garden. Are 'children' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Children' is the plural of 'child' and can be counted (one child, two children). 'Children' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: I don't like milk. Is 'milk' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Milk' is a liquid and cannot be counted individually. 'Milk' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: I prefer tea. Is 'tea' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Tea' as a drink/liquid is uncountable. 'Tea' (အဖျော်ရည်) ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: Scientists say that the environment is threatened by pollution. Is 'scientists' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Scientists' is the plural of 'scientist' and can be counted. 'Scientists' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: My mother uses butter to prepare cakes. Is 'butter' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Butter' is a food substance that cannot be counted. 'Butter' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: There are a lot of windows in our classroom. Is 'windows' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Windows' is the plural of 'window' and can be counted. 'Windows' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: We need some glue to fix this vase. Is 'glue' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Glue' is a substance that cannot be counted. 'Glue' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: The waiters in this restaurant are very professional. Is 'waiters' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Waiters' is the plural of 'waiter' and can be counted. 'Waiters' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: My father drinks two big glasses of water every morning. Is 'water' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Water' is a liquid and cannot be counted. 'Water' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: The bread my mother prepares is delicious. Is 'bread' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Bread' is a food substance that is uncountable. 'Bread' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: Drivers must be careful; the road is slippery. Is 'drivers' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Drivers' is the plural of 'driver' and can be counted. 'Drivers' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: Some policemen are organizing road traffic. Is 'policemen' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Policemen' is the plural of 'policeman' and can be counted. 'Policemen' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: I bought three bottles of mineral water for our picnic. Is 'water' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Water' is uncountable. We count it using containers like 'bottles of water'. 'Water' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ၊ container တွေနဲ့ ရေတွက်ရပါတယ်။

questions.question: I would like some juice please! Is 'juice' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Juice' is a liquid and is uncountable. 'Juice' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: Successful candidates will join the camp later this year. Is 'candidates' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Candidates' is the plural of 'candidate' and can be counted. 'Candidates' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: A rise in oil prices is inevitable since there is more and more world demand for energy. Is 'oil' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Oil' as a substance is uncountable. 'Oil' (ဆီ) ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: The exercises on this website are interesting. Is 'exercises' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Exercises' is the plural of 'exercise' and can be counted. 'Exercises' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: Dehydrated babies must drink a lot of water. Is 'water' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Water' is a liquid and is uncountable. 'Water' ကို ရေတွက်မရပါ။

questions.question: Adult illiterates learn through a special government program. Is 'illiterates' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'Illiterates' refers to people who cannot read and can be counted. 'Illiterates' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: I met some nice people when I was walking along the beach. Is 'people' countable or uncountable?
questions.explanation: 'People' is the plural of 'person' and can be counted. 'People' ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်ပါတယ်။
